test_pybind11_class_repr: test that pybind11 bound class types produce correct repr strings containing pybind11_type
test_pybind11_class_instance: test that pybind11 classes without constructors raise TypeError and track alive instance counts
test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance with Pet, Dog, Rabbit, and Hamster polymorphic behavior
test_pybind11_class_type_checking: test pybind11 type introspection functions check_type, get_type_of, and as_type on bound classes
test_pybind11_class_docstrings: test that pybind11 bound classes and methods have correct docstrings, qualnames, and module names
